purpose: Stabilize the outcome-blind operational Nash tie-break after V1 validation exposed same-window herding and assignment churn; preserve the paper utility, welfare, and offline-reference objective.

v1_diagnostic_basis.diagnosis: The V1 penalty used only the pre-window runtime queue and warm-container state. Near-indifferent players repeatedly selected the same apparently warm node, causing same-window herding, assignment churn, and frequent solver iteration limits. V2 adds projected current-window load and an old-assignment switch threshold.

development_stages.execution_policy: Run and audit one candidate at a time. Stop early only when a candidate passes every selection gate and dominates every later candidate's pre-registered upper-bound gate; otherwise continue in the fixed order.

selection_rule.comparison: candidate versus frozen first-version NSESche and all frozen baselines on the same load and seed block
eligibility: all runs pass protocol QC and pairing
for every load, geometric-mean throughput ratio versus first-version NSESche is at least 0.98
for every load, geometric-mean QPR ratio versus first-version NSESche is at least 0.98
overall geometric-mean latency ratio versus first-version NSESche is at most 1.10
overall geometric-mean cost ratio versus first-version NSESche is at most 1.10
selection_rule.primary_score: minimum over loads of min(mean-throughput margin to the best frozen baseline, mean-QPR margin to the best frozen baseline), followed by overall geometric mean of throughput and QPR ratios versus first-version NSESche
tie_breaks: higher minimum load-level throughput/QPR ratio versus first-version NSESche
fewer assignment moves per solver player
selection_rule.failure_action: If no candidate is eligible or none approaches rank one, revise using only E01-E10 diagnostics and preregister a new version. Do not inspect E11-E20 performance.

development_validation_rule.rank_requirement: For every load, candidate mean fixed-window throughput and mean QPR must each rank first against all frozen E01-E10 baselines.

confirmatory_stage.closure_requirement: For each load, optimized NSESche must rank first in both mean fixed-window throughput and mean QPR against the frozen baselines; otherwise report not closed without deleting seeds based on performance.
